name: WildSplat
definition: A feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for appearance-conditioned novel-view synthesis from sparse, unposed, in-the-wild images. It explicitly decouples geometry from appearance to handle inconsistent photometric conditions.
summary: WildSplat is a feedforward Gaussian Splatting framework that decouples geometry from appearance to synthesize novel views from sparse, unposed images under varying lighting.
